title: ack context remind
summary: Combine successor-chat recovery with scope and evidence reminders before sustained continuation.

situation.trigger: A prior conversation reached its limit and the user wants the successor to retain accountability and scope.

appropriate_when: A project is continuing in a new conversation
History recovery and progress credibility are both relevant
not_appropriate_when: The user only asks for a diagnostic snapshot
The prior project or its scope cannot be established
preconditions: Rebuild from available evidence; do not treat missing context as verified

expected_behavior.purpose: Combine successor-chat recovery with scope and evidence reminders before sustained continuation.

tradeoffs: Do not overinvest in process checks at the expense of useful authorized work
